items.result: A measured NO_GO now returns process exit code 1; GO and audit-only pending states return 0.

items.finding: The historic Markdown calls the object's absolute post-detach displacement 'detached motion' without stating that it is diagnostic rather than the acceptance threshold. The executable gate and machine evidence use hand motion and hand/object relative change. No threshold was relaxed, and the frozen B0 source was not edited.

_world_pose_xyzw reads UsdGeom.XformCache().GetLocalToWorldTransform for dynamic robot and cylinder poses after the timeline starts. That can return the authored transform instead of the live PhysX pose.
items.scope_boundary: S3 physical sample acceptance and recovery metrics come from isaac_m1b_actuation_probe.py, whose _live_pose reads RigidPrim.get_world_poses from the PhysX tensor backend. The affected benchmark fields are not used to accept S3 samples.
items.required_follow_up: Before a future dynamic dataset benchmark is accepted, replace the helper with a live PhysX pose reader and verify movement on Isaac Sim. Do not reinterpret old authored-pose records as live motion evidence.

items.result: cylinder_pose computes vertical support from projected half-length plus projected radius and adds the spawn clearance; tilted cylinders no longer reuse the upright half-length offset.

blockers: The dynamic benchmark live-pose defect remains open and requires an Isaac runtime verification before affected outputs can be accepted.
Q-B remains forbidden until a separate human expressivity ADR is committed.
